item.title: Welcome to My Blog
item.description:
Welcome to my personal blog! This is a space where I share my thoughts, projects, and insights on bioinformatics, research engineering, and computational biology.

About This Site

This blog is built with Hugo, a fast and flexible static site generator, and hosted on GitHub Pages. The clean, minimal design reflects my preference for professional, distraction-free content.

What to Expect

Here you’ll find:

  • Technical articles on bioinformatics and data science
  • Project showcases and case studies
  • Research insights and methodologies
  • Tutorials and guides

Stay tuned for more content!
